W57

Grading allocation and deadline planner

/teach/courses/:courseId/grading-plan
Roles: instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S17, S12

Allocate grading work and independent staff deadlines that drive the TA calendar and queue from the same task record.

W48 grading queueW07 staff calendarW45 staff scope
Layout regions
Assessment planReceived/expected work, questions and instructor review target
Allocation gridTA, learner/group/question intersection, workload and access end
TimelineGrading due, review and release target dates; conflicts and task history

Dialogs and drawers (2)
Apply grading plan
  • Task additions/removals, assignees, exact scope and old/new due times
  • No learner deadlines or releases change
Return without applying changesApply reviewed tasks
Unsaved changes
  • Name the current draft and changed fields; show save destination and whether sample storage is available.
  • Discard restores the last saved draft, never deletes received work or published history.
Keep editingSave draft and return, or explicitly discard changes
Permissions
  • Instructor alone allocates, reassigns and changes grading due dates.
  • TA reads current own task records and opens assigned work until access expires; no self-escalation.
  • Grading due, student due/close and quiz timers are separate fields with separate owners.
Responsive
  • Wide web uses allocation grid plus deadline timeline; narrow web uses assignee/task cards with explicit learner/question scope.
  • Coverage gaps/overlaps and access-end conflicts remain above Apply; task edit form preserves course zone and grading-due label.
Accessibility
  • Provide non-drag assignee/scope controls and a table/list alternative to timeline; identify each overlap by task/question.
  • Read grading due separately from student due/close. Errors link to scope or date fields; task changes announce affected count without exposing hidden learners.
Data
  • One versioned grading-task ID supplies home, calendar and queue, with assignee, receipt/question scope, grading due and access window.
  • Instructor previews complete coverage; TA receives own tasks only. Reassignment retains confirmed scores, prior attribution and deadline history.
Acceptance checks (4)
  • One task edit updates calendar and queue consistently without duplicate events.
  • A TA sees only their own work-calendar tasks and assigned learner/question records.
  • Reassignment preserves saved scores and never marks unreviewed questions complete.
  • Saving an incomplete draft preserves entered fields with draft status; publishing/applying remains blocked until consequential validation passes. Cancel keeps published/received history unchanged.
Notes
  • NEW PROPOSED web template; legacy IDs/map unchanged.
  • HTML planning only; no backend/integrations.
